entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like to talk to you about something.[n]Do you have a moment?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Up until now, I've been the[n]quintessential honor student.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I believe I've been handling my position[n]as student council president with ease[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: A-And I don't mean that in a boasting[n]way, that's simply how I've thought[n]about it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...But in the end, I was unable to make[n]any kind of impact with either Suzui-san[n]or Kaneshiro.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Turns out there's no use for a rule-abiding[n]honor student when things get rough.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now that I'm a member of this team,[n]I want to do everything I can to help[n]you all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: All my studying up to this point has[n]kept me quite narrow-minded.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think... I-I will need to broaden[n]my horizons somewhat.
What do you plan on doing?
Way to go, advisor!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Advisor...? Hmph, all right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: My first step will be to learn more about[n]the other students.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... I struggle with that. There seems[n]to be a disparity between my tastes and[n]those of my peers...
That's not true.
You're totally right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Really? I hope you're right...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But I don't even know where people like[n]to go for fun...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It would be nice to have a grasp of such[n]concepts.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I knew it...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't even know where people like[n]to go for fun...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It would be nice to have a grasp of such[n]concepts.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Plus, the student council must be[n]responsible for understanding the[n]student body they serve, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I-I don't mean that in a surveillance way,[n]I just want to know them as people.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I may be a phantom thief, but that's[n]no excuse for me to start ignoring[n]my presidential duties.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now, back to the topic at hand...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Where do people usually go for fun?
The movie theater.
Karaoke.
The arcade.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I enjoy the movies myself, sometimes.[n]I think I'd prefer somewhere I'm[n]unfamiliar with...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, I know! How about the arcade?[n]I've never actually been to one.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Karaoke, hm? My friends have taken me[n]there a few times...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If possible, I-I'd like to go somewhere[n]I'm a little less familiar with...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How about an arcade? I've never actually[n]been to one.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ah, I often hear people talking about[n]going to the arcade.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To be perfectly honest, I've never been[n]to one myself...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you think you could take me?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not sure if it will broaden my[n]horizons per se, but simply studying[n]won't get me anywhere.
Let's go now.
It'll be a field trip.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank goodness... I think I would have[n]been totally lost in there had I gone[n]by myself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, let's get going.
